wland.arch.description: Natural rock arch: two lumpy layered legs joined by a sagging lofted span (a seeded lumpy section swept along an arch curve); walkable underneath, a postcard landmark.

wland.boulder.description: Desert boulders: faceted rounded rocks (one big, smaller companions) bedded into the sand.

wland.butte.description: Butte / chimney rock: a narrow tower of layered rock on a talus cone, a slightly overhanging cap rock and a flat top; the far-silhouette landmark of a canyon.

wland.canyon_wall.description: Canyon wall: a one-sided layered red-rock face on the lot line with stepped strata ledges, desert-varnish beds, a buttressed crest and a receding mesa-top cap; straight runs tile end to end, corner turns 90 degrees inward, end / end_w slope down to the canyon floor toward the piece's east / west end.

wland.dead_tree.description: Dead desert tree: a gnarled, leaning bleached trunk (swept tube) with crooked bare branches forking up.

wland.grass.description: Dry bunch grass: a tuft of tapered straw blades (closed thin spines) splaying from a small base.

wland.ground.description: Desert ground patch: a one-sided terrain sheet of painted sand that settles to the floor datum at its edges; dunes add soft wind-blown swells, ruts paint a wagon road (path role) across the middle.

wland.hoodoo.description: Hoodoos: eroded rock spires with pinched waists (lathe of an irregular profile) wearing hard flat cap stones; a cluster of one to four.

wland.ledge.description: Rock shelf: a raised layered rock step (closed loft) with a flat sandy top to climb onto; stacks into terraces.

wland.mesa.description: Free-standing mesa: a broad talus skirt, layered steep flanks with a hard cap-rock ledge and a flat scrubby top; a closed loft of seeded lumpy rings (beds share their jitter so the strata read as continuous layers).

wland.oasis.description: Oasis: a sunken pool of still water ringed by rocks and grass tufts, shaded by fan palms; the green surprise of a canyon floor.

wland.palm.description: Desert fan palm: a ringed curving trunk, a shaggy skirt of dead fronds and a crown of fan fronds (two-sided cards).

wland.riverbed.description: Dry riverbed (wash): a one-sided terrain block with a sunken sandy channel between sloped cracked-earth banks that rise back to the floor datum toward the block edges, scattered river stones along the bed; a large block is a whole canyon floor.

wland.scrub.description: Sagebrush / desert scrub: a low mound of lumpy grey-green foliage blobs on twiggy stems, wider than tall.

wland.slope.description: Talus ramp: a closed wedge of packed scree rising from the floor to a ledge top (walkable slope), lumpy flanks and a few loose stones at its foot.

wland.yucca.description: Yucca: a rosette of stiff sword leaves (closed tapered spines) radiating from a short trunk, with an optional tall flower stalk.

wmine.cart.description: Ore cart: a tapered riveted tub on a timber frame with four small painted wheels and couplers; loaded with a heap of ore or empty, optionally tipped on its side as wreckage dressing.

wmine.headframe.description: Timber headframe over a mine shaft: four battered legs with girts and X-bracing, back braces, a sheave wheel (painted disc) on top, a hoist rope down to a cage and a timber shaft collar with a dark shaft card. Origin on the shaft centre (back braces reach 4 m behind).

wmine.ladder.description: Wall ladder of split poles with lashed rungs, leaning slightly; wall-mounted dressing for shafts, lofts and galleries.

wmine.ore_bin.description: Ore bin (tipple): a sloped-bottom plank bin on four timber stilts with cross bracing and a hinged chute over a track, a ramp-side catwalk rail on top.

wmine.ore_pile.description: Spoil / ore heap: a low rounded mound of faceted rock lumps with a few loose stones around its foot.

wmine.portal.description: Mine entrance: a one-sided rock cliff face with a cut opening on a door socket (the runtime timber frame is wtown.doorway), dark tunnel depth behind it, horizontal lagging logs over the cap and a blank sign board above.

wmine.rubble.description: Cave-in rubble: a heap of broken rock with a snapped timber post and a fallen cap beam across it.

wmine.shaft.description: Shaft collar: a square timber frame around a dark shaft opening in the floor, guard rails on three sides and a ladder top; reads as a way down.

wmine.timber_set.description: Standalone mine timber set: two battered posts, a cap beam with blocking wedges; spans a 3 m passage, a cave mouth or a shoring line.

wmine.track.description: Narrow-gauge mine track (0.6 m): straight cell, a 2 m radius cell corner (south to east) or a buffer end with a timber chock; light sleepers on a thin ballast bed.

wmine.tunnel.description: Mine tunnel cell (4 m): one-sided rough rock walls around a 3 m passage, a dirt floor and a low rock ceiling, timber sets (battered posts, cap, wedges) every 2 m. Kinds: straight, corner, tee, cross, end, end_door (the north arm runs out through a door socket on the room edge: the runtime timber frame, dark drift depth beyond, or with daylight the bright desert seen through the mine mouth). Joins on tunnel sockets at cell-edge midpoints.

wmine.windlass.description: Hand windlass over a prospect hole: two A-frame uprights, a log drum with a crank handle, rope down to a wooden bucket, a plank collar around a dark hole.

wprop.bar.description: Saloon bar: a long panelled counter with a polished top, a brass foot rail and a raised lip; or the back bar - shelving of bottles (painted shelf texture) under a cornice with a mirror panel.

wprop.barrel.description: Barrel: a bulged stave barrel with iron hoops; keg (squat), water barrel (lid and dipper), powder keg (painted band) or tipped on its side.

wprop.bottles.description: Table dressing: whiskey bottles (lathe, glass role) and short glasses in a little cluster.

wprop.bucket.description: Small vessel: a stave bucket with a rope bail, a brass spittoon, or a tin wash basin.

wprop.cactus.description: Desert cactus: a ribbed columnar saguaro with upturned arms, an organ-pipe clump of stems, a prickly pear of flat pads with red fruit, or a squat barrel cactus with a flower crown.

wprop.campfire.description: Campfire: a ring of stones around crossed logs with emissive flame cards and a warm baked light.

wprop.chair.description: Seat: a spindle-back saloon chair, a bar stool, a rocking chair on curved runners, or a plank bench.

wprop.crate.description: Crate: a chamfered box with board edges (crate), an open slatted crate, a long box (rifle / tool box) or a stencilled powder box with rope handles.

wprop.hay.description: Hay: a bound rectangular bale (rounded, twine bands) or a small stack of three bales.

wprop.lantern.description: Lamp: a hanging barn lantern with a wire bail, a wall bracket lantern, a street lamp on a post, or a table oil lamp with a glass chimney; the glowing glass is emissive and night packs bake a warm pool around it.

wprop.piano.description: Upright saloon piano: a tall cabinet with a fallboard and keyboard shelf, turned front legs, a music rest and a round stool.

wprop.sacks.description: Grain / flour sacks: soft tied bags slumped against each other.

wprop.saloon_doors.description: Freestanding batwing saloon doors for an interior doorway: two scalloped half-height leaves on hinge posts with a lintel board.

wprop.signpost.description: Crossroads signpost: a tall post with blank pointed direction boards at different headings and heights.

wprop.skull.description: Bleached steer skull: a tapered muzzle and brow with dark eye sockets and long curved horns; desert dressing.

wprop.stove.description: Pot-belly stove: a bulging cast-iron lathe body on three short legs with a glowing grate window and a stovepipe rising to the ceiling.

wprop.table.description: Table: a round saloon table on a turned pedestal, a square four-legged table, a card table with a felt top, or a long trestle table with benches' height.

wprop.tombstone.description: Grave marker: a round-topped headstone on a plinth, a timber cross, a painted wooden board marker, or a cairn of stones over a low mound.

wprop.trough.description: Water trough: a long plank trough on splayed legs with iron end bands and still water inside.

wprop.wagon.description: Wagon: a covered prairie wagon (plank box, canvas hoops, spoked painted wheels, tongue), an open buckboard with a bench seat, or a broken wreck with a fallen wheel.

wprop.wanted_board.description: Notice board: a plank board in a frame (on two posts with a little roof, or wall-mounted) pinned with blank wanted posters (empty heading and portrait frame, no text).

wprop.well.description: Fieldstone well: a round stone curb (lathe with a coping lip) around dark water, two posts carrying a log windlass with crank and rope bucket, and a little shingle roof.

wprop.wheel.description: Spare wagon wheel: a painted spoked wheel leaning against a wall (or lying flat).

wprop.windmill.description: Water-pumping windmill: a tapering four-leg lattice tower with girts and cross braces, a multi-blade fan wheel, a tail vane, a pump rod down to a pump head over a round stock tank.

wrail.car.description: Freight car on two four-wheel trucks: a board-and-batten boxcar with a curved roof and sliding door, a flatcar with stake pockets and a lashed load, or a caboose with a rooftop cupola and end platforms.

wrail.handcar.description: Pump handcar: a plank deck on four small painted wheels with a timber frame, a central A-frame and a see-saw pump lever with cross handles at both ends.

wrail.locomotive.description: Small frontier steam locomotive: a tapered boiler with a flared smokestack, steam and sand domes, a square headlamp, a pilot, two big painted driving wheels and one small leading wheel a side, and a cab with a curved roof and side windows.

wrail.platform.description: Station platform module (4 m): a raised plank deck with a timber edge beam on posts, end ramp on end pieces. Lot-line piece joining end to end on walk sockets, the track runs along its front.

wrail.signal.description: Semaphore signal: a tapered timber mast with a ladder, a painted arm on a pivot, a lamp box with a lit lens and a finial cap.

wrail.station.description: Small frontier depot: a board-and-batten building under a low gable with deep overhanging eaves on knee braces over the platform, a projecting telegrapher's bay window, a ticket window, a plank door, a blank station-name board on the gable and a raised plank platform along the front.

wrail.track.description: Standard-gauge track on a ballast berm: straight 4 m cell, 90 degree curve of 6 m radius over a 2 x 2 block, a timber buffer stop, or a road crossing (plank fill between and beside the rails). Joins on track sockets at cell-edge midpoints.

wrail.trestle.description: Timber trestle bridge module (4 m): a bent of four battered posts with cap, sill and X-bracing under a deck of stringers, sleepers and rails with guard timbers; modules join on track sockets, 'end' adds a cribbed log abutment.

wsky.dome.description: Frontier sky dome: inward-facing hemisphere (kit_shell_sky, role sky, u = azimuth, v = elevation; the horizon sits at v = 0.0875, matching the wk_sky texture's distant mesas and horizon haze). The pack variant paints noon, golden hour, night or canyon skies onto the same dome.

wsky.mesas.description: Distant mesa ring: an inward-facing band whose top edge follows seeded butte and mesa silhouettes (flat tops, steep shoulders), painted with the vista haze gradient; sits inside the sky dome between the playfield and the painted horizon so the far skyline has real parallax.

wsky.sun.description: Sun / moon disc: a single emissive octagonal card (role light) to hang high in the backdrop, facing the viewer.

wtown.balcony.description: Upper balcony for a two-storey frontage: a plank deck on diagonal knee braces with a railing. Lot-line piece in front of the facade at the second-storey floor.

wtown.bank.description: Bank: a two-storey fieldstone block with a flat roof, a heavy bracketed cornice and stepped parapet, a string course, round-arched ground-floor windows and door, tall upper windows and a blank name plaque.

wtown.boardwalk.description: Raised plank boardwalk module along a lot line (4 m long, 2 m deep, 0.3 m high): painted planks over joist posts; end_w / end_e close one end with a plank step, steps adds a step down in front, ends closes both.

wtown.church.description: Frontier chapel: white-washed lap siding under a steep shingle roof, a square front tower with louvred belfry, a tapering spire crowned by a simple cross, pointed-arch windows and double doors at the top of three plank steps.

wtown.doorway.description: Timber doorway frame on the door anchor (bound as arch.door): two chamfered posts, a heavy header beam with corbels and a threshold board, 2.4 x 3.0 m clear. Reads as a door casing on a facade, a ranch gate in a fence line and the timber set of a mine portal; 'gate' adds a blank hanging sign under the header.

wtown.facade.description: False-front shop facade on a shallow gabled body: shaped parapet (square / stepped / arched / gabled / pediment / tall), cornice, blank sign board, door and window(s), optional porch roof or striped awning; the cheap filler that makes a main street.

wtown.fence.description: Fence segment along one cell edge (4 m): ranch rails, a cemetery picket fence, a gateway (two tall posts and rail stubs around a 2.4 m gap that carries a door socket for road exits) or a broken run with a fallen rail.

wtown.gallery.description: Interior gallery (mezzanine) along a wall: a plank floor on posts at the upper storey with a railing along the front; a gap in the railing at one end meets a wtown.stairs flight. Origin on the room's inner wall line.

wtown.hitching_post.description: Hitching rail: rough hewn posts with a worn top rail and iron tie rings.

wtown.hotel.description: Two-storey hotel: side-gabled shingle roof with two dormers, a two-level veranda across the front (posts, upper gallery with railing, shed roof), a long blank sign board between the floors and rows of windows.

wtown.porch.description: Porch roof / awning over a boardwalk: a sloped plank (or striped canvas, or tin) roof from the facade to two or three posts at the boardwalk edge. Lot-line piece in front of a building frontage.

wtown.room.description: Frontier interior shell on the 4 m grid: one-sided walls with a baseboard, plank wainscot under a chair rail, papered upper walls and a crown board, a plank floor, a plank ceiling with chamfered beams, door cuts on cell-edge midpoints for the timber doorway frame, painted window views and wall lamp sockets.

wtown.saloon.description: Two-storey frontier saloon: lap-sided body under a shingle gable, a tall shaped false front with a bracketed cornice and a blank sign board, an upper balcony on posts with a railing, batwing doors between two windows, upper windows and a stovepipe.

wtown.shack.description: Homesteader's shack: a small board-and-batten cabin with a corrugated tin (or shingle) gable roof, a crooked stovepipe, one window, a plank door and a little porch on two posts.

wtown.sheriff.description: Sheriff's office and jail: a lap-sided office with a pediment false front, blank plaque and porch roof beside a fieldstone cell block with small barred windows.

wtown.stable.description: Livery stable: a steep-gabled barn of painted board-and-batten facing the street, big double doors, a hayloft door under a hoist beam with a pulley and rope, a vent cupola on the ridge and an open lean-to on one side.

wtown.stairs.description: Exterior or interior plank stair to a balcony or gallery: a solid sawtooth stair block (stringer profile on the sides) with an open handrail on posts.

wtown.store.description: General store: one storey with a tall false front, cornice and blank sign, two big display windows, a plank door and a shingled porch roof on posts over the boardwalk.

wtown.water_tower.description: Water tower: a stave tank with a conical shingle cap on four splayed timber legs with X-bracing and girts, an octagonal deck, a side ladder and (optional) a hinged spout chute for the railroad.

note: Every GLB here exists for consumers only with this sha256 (explicit sRGB8, converted after the kit validators and the WESTERNKIT gates ran on the linear build; source_sha256 = validated build). textures are relative to kits/library/.
